items.prompt: A photorealistic 2:3 vertical fine-art photograph captures a clearly adult Korean woman in her twenties standing quietly beneath a secluded natural water shower deep inside a lush, rain-damp forest. Her pale silver shoulder-length hair has become naturally wet, separating into fine individual strands that cling softly around her temples, cheeks, and neck, with tiny droplets collecting along the hair and catching the subdued light. She has fair luminous skin rendered with authentic pores, subtle tonal variation, and realistic human texture rather than artificial perfection. She wears a simple white sleeveless mini dress made from lightweight chiffon, its fabric naturally darkened and gently weighted by moisture, forming believable folds as water continuously passes over it. Her posture is relaxed and unforced, shoulders lowered, head turned slightly toward the falling water, one hand quietly touching a damp strand of hair while her expression remains contemplative and inward-looking. The setting feels secluded and untouched: moss-covered stones, wet ferns, broad rain-darkened leaves, ancient tree trunks, shallow reflective water, suspended mist, and layers of humid vegetation receding into atmospheric depth. Compose the portrait asymmetrically, placing her slightly off-center and allowing the waterfall, surrounding foliage, and negative space to become part of the visual story rather than treating the forest as a backdrop. Soft overcast daylight filters through the canopy, with restrained backlight illuminating the mist and individual droplets while gentle shadows preserve depth and skin detail. Photograph with a full-frame mirrorless camera and an 85mm lens at f/2.8 for intimate compression, natural facial perspective, and selective separation without destroying environmental context. Use KODAK PORTRA 800, whose fine grain, forgiving latitude, soft contrast, and graceful skin rendering suit the delicate combination of luminous skin, white fabric, cool wet foliage, and subdued natural light. Preserve realistic anatomy, gravity, water movement, fabric behavior, optical depth, and atmospheric perspective, creating an image that feels discovered rather than staged, intimate without being theatrical, and unmistakably grounded in physical photographic reality.
items.title: 森林光影女性人像
